description: This PHP source file defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_Literals class, which provides methods for managing literals in Smarty templates such as getLiterals, addLiterals, setLiterals, and an internal helper set method.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_Literals
classes.description: Provides methods to get, add, set, and manage literal values in Smarty templates.

methods.name: getLiterals
methods.description: Returns the list of literals associated with a Smarty template object.

methods.name: addLiterals
methods.description: Adds literals to the Smarty object, potentially merging with existing literals.

methods.name: setLiterals
methods.description: Replaces the current literals in the Smarty object with a new set.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Internal helper to set literals, ensuring they do not conflict with delimiters and merging new literals.
